FULL TEXT:
DEPARTMENT OF MATHEMATICS
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH
(Accredited with A++ Grade by NAAC)Dated: 20-2-2024
APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF GUEST FACULTY
Applications are invited from eligible candidates for the post of One Guest Faculty to teach Subjects of
Statistics at Department of Mathematics, Panjab University, Chandigarh for the Even Semester (Academic
Session 2023-2024 onwards).
Educational Qualifications :
As per UGC & P.U. Guidelines
(i) Good Academic record as defined by concerned University with Master’s degree with 55% marks
(50% marks in case of SC/ST) or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system
is followed) in Statistics from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited
foreign University.
(ii) Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility
Test (NET) conducted by UGC or must fulfil the other UGC Regulations for recruitment and
appointment as Assistant Professor or equivalent positions in the University/College/Institute.
(iii) The candidates, who are, or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University
Grants Commission (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of Ph.D. Degree) Regulations,
2009, shall be exempted from the requirement of the minimum eligibility condition of NET for
recruitment and appointment of Assistant Professor or equivalent positions in Universities/
Colleges/Institutions.
Desirable:
Ph.D. degree in Statistics and teaching experience of Graduate/Post-Graduate classes in the field of
respective subject.
The above assignment is on lecture basis with a token of honorarium of Rs. 1500/- per lecture with
an upper limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month. The candidate shall have to undertake that he/she will not
draw any fellowship/stipend or any financial assistance from any agency and will do the same till
they are teaching in Department of Mathematics as a Guest Faculty and no criminal proceedings,
charge-sheets, police cases, cases of moral misconduct or court cases against them.
Selection Process:
Eligible candidates will be called for interview in the Seminar Hall, Department of Mathematics, Panjab
University, Chandigarh.
Last Date:
Applications to be submitted latest by 29-2-2024 upto 4.00 p.m. in the office of Department of
Mathematics, Panjab University, Chandigarh.
Interview:
The interview of Eligible candidates for the post of One Guest Faculty will held on 5-3-2024 at
12.15 p.m to 1.30 p.m.in the Seminar Hall, Department of Mathematics, Panjab University, Chandigarh.
The applications form for the post of Guest Faculty (Assistant Professor) is available at website
http://jobs.puchd.ac.in/forms.php. You are advised to visit the notice board of the department website:
http://maths.puchd.ac.in for any further update.
• Working hours for the appointee will be 9.00 am to 5.00 pm.
• No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview.
--Sd--
Chairperson
Department of Mathematics
